jobs.title: Senior M&A Integration Manager
jobs.description:
Company Overview
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview
Supply Chain M&A Department

The Supply Chain M&A Department drives growth and operational continuity by managing end-to-end supply chain strategy across mergers and acquisitions. We lead comprehensive due diligence to identify synergies and manage risks, while executing seamless integration strategies across procurement, logistics, and operations to ensure the full value of every deal is realized. Central to our mission is supporting newly acquired team members—delivering a welcoming, structured transition that helps them acclimate quickly to MSI’s culture, systems, and operations.
Job Description
The successful candidate will take primary accountability for post-signing integration planning and execution, allowing the team to flex bandwidth between diligence and integration as deal flow requires. Given our unique alignment under the CFO, this individual will bridge the gap between operational supply chain execution and hard financial metrics, ensuring all acquired businesses successfully scale to meet our Vision 2030 goals.

Key Responsibilities
- Integration Strategy & Execution: Lead end-to-end post-signing integration activities, designing and executing Day 1 readiness plans, 100-day integration roadmaps, and TSA exit strategies.

- Financial Modeling & Synergy Tracking: Partner closely with Corp Dev and FP&A to build models for ROI, operating costs, and capital investments.

- Post-Merger Value Realization: Rigorously track and report on synergy commitments to withstand executive and CFO scrutiny while driving committed business outcomes.

- Executive Reporting: Establish robust, comprehensive, and repeatable status updates, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms for the Senior Leadership Team (SLT) and broader business units.

- Cross-Functional Consensus: Drive alignment, operational prioritization, and change management across cross-functional integration teams, including Go-To-Market (GTM), Sales, Product, HR, IT, and Supply Chain.

- Portfolio Scaling: Initially manage integration within the Supply Chain and Business Operations ecosystem (including, but not limited to hardware, software, and services across international and domestic targets), with the explicit expectation to expand scope into IT integration over time.

- Execution & Strategy Mix : Address the integration backlog while developing and implementing an integration playbook and center of excellence and planning and executing the integration of new acquisitions.

Experience:
- Proven track record of leading corporate post-merger integrations (PMI) either within a corporate environment or through a top-tier management consulting firm.

- Practical, hands-on experience managing complex M&A integration lifecycles (Day 1, 100-day plans, synergy capturing).

- Demonstrated experience in supply chain/operations, though diverse industry backgrounds (e.g., tech, industrial, consumer, healthcare, financial services) will be considered if accompanied by strong PMI mastery.

Skills & Capabilities:
- Strong financial acumen with the ability to translate operational milestones into P&L impact (revenue retention, working capital, ROI).

- Expert-level project management capabilities, including utilization of modern integration and synergy tracking tools.

- Outstanding communication skills, with a verified ability to comfortably present to and influence executive stakeholders, targets, and cross-functional peers.

- Availability: Preferred to onboard immediately

Education:
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain, or a related technical field.

- An MBA or advanced degree  in Business is highly preferred.

Job Description
About the Role
Join Motorola Solutions’ Video organization in Penang! We are seeking an experienced R&D Program Manager to lead end-to-end product development lifecycles for mission-critical radio, video and security ecosystem solutions. In this role, you will drive cross-functional engineering squads across a matrixed organization partnering with engineering functional heads to deliver complex hardware, software, and integrated system products on time and within budget.

Key Responsibilities

- End-to-End Governance & Lifecycle Management: Drive complex programs from initiation through baseline to market launch in strict compliance with the development lifecycle.
- Schedule Architecture & Executive Visibility: Build, manage, and communicate clear executive schedules using enterprise tools such as Smartsheet or Microsoft Project. Track critical path dependencies, manage established schedule baselines, and present transparent health updates to senior stakeholders.
- Baseline & Scope Control: Govern program scope and manage design or milestone changes via formal Change Control Board (CCB) approvals.
- Matrixed Resource & Capacity Alignment: Work closely with the Business team and Engineering Department Head to align resource loading against product roadmaps, ensuring optimal headcount utilization across functional disciplines.
- Risk Mitigation & Schedule Compression: Proactively identify critical path bottlenecks, lead crisis recovery efforts for troubled milestones, and apply schedule compression techniques (such as fast-tracking or crashing) while accounting for quarter-end operational constraints.
- Supplier & Partner Execution: Lead Statement of Work (SOW) sign-offs for outsourced programs, managing external vendor, JDM, or ODM deliverables to ensure quality and contract compliance.
- Process Compliance & Escalations: Act as the primary point of contact for program escalations. Ensure full compliance with quality, regulatory (e.g., FCC, country type approvals, carrier certifications), and reliability standards while maintaining complete artifacts in the program repository.

Basic Requirements
What You Bring (Requirements)

- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical & Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Telecommunications, or an equivalent technical field.
- Experience: 5 to 8+ years of proven project/program management experience driving multi-disciplinary hardware, software, and system solutions within the technology or telecommunications sector.
- Matrix Leadership & Conflict Resolution: Proven ability to navigate complex "people puzzles," resolve interdependency friction, and drive accountability across cross-functional engineering teams without direct administrative line authority.
- Methodology & Tools: Expert-level mastery of project management scheduling tools (Smartsheet or MS Project), Agile/Scrum frameworks, Jira, and formal gated product lifecycles.
- AI Tool Adoption: Demonstrated experience integrating modern AI tools into daily workflows to improve schedule analysis, risk tracking, and operational output quality.

- PMP or PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP) certification.
- Hands-on experience managing global ODM/JDM hardware development partners.

- Strong Writing & Proofreading: Ability to write clearly, concisely, and accurately under tight timelines, with exceptional attention to detail.

- Good Judgment & Discretion: Sharp news awareness and absolute discretion when handling sensitive, non-public corporate topics.
- Proactive & Eager to Learn: High energy, curiosity, and a positive "go-getter" attitude with a desire to build expertise in communications operations.

- Collaborative Team Player: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively with team members and cross-functional colleague

- 3+ years of progressive professional communications experience (corporate or PR agency background preferred).

jobs.description:
Company Overview

We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview
About Us:
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that exceptional customer and user experiences are born from a deep understanding of user needs, powered by insightful data, and brought to life through thoughtful design. Our team is a dynamic, multidisciplinary group, bringing together talented Industrial Designers, UX/CX Designers, User Researchers, and Human Factors practitioners. We are at the forefront of understanding our users and translating those insights into impactful products and services. Now, as we embrace the transformative potential of Artificial Intelligence, we're excited to expand our team with creative minds who can help us redefine what's possible.
The Opportunity: Integrate AI into World-Class User Experiences
We are seeking talented and forward-thinking AI-Focused Experience Designers and to join our innovative team. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of human-centered design, cutting-edge research methodologies, and artificial intelligence.
You won't just be working with AI; you'll be shaping how AI enhances and transforms the user experience. You'll collaborate closely with our existing experts in ID, CX, UX, and Research, as well as with data scientists and engineers, to envision, design, and evaluate AI-driven solutions that are intuitive, ethical, and truly valuable to our users. Your work will directly contribute to our strategic goal of leading our industry through AI-powered innovation.
Job Description
What You'll Do (Core Responsibilities Adaptable by Role):
- Adapt to rapidly shifting priorities and contribute to an agile, fast-paced innovation environment.

- Champion a user-centered approach in the development and application of AI technologies.

- Demonstrate compelling storytelling skills as well as a command of design thinking principles and best practices

- Identify opportunities to leverage AI (ML, NLP, generative AI) to solve user problems and create novel, delightful experiences.

- Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to translate AI capabilities into tangible user benefits and design requirements.

- Design and/or research user interactions with AI-powered features and systems, ensuring they are intuitive, transparent, and trustworthy.

- Contribute to the development of best practices, ethical guidelines, and design patterns for Human-AI interaction within our organization.

- Stay abreast of the latest advancements in AI and their potential applications in experience design and market fit.

- Effectively communicate findings, design concepts, and AI possibilities to diverse audiences.

- AI Literacy: A strong understanding of core Artificial Intelligence concepts, including Machine Learning (ML), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Generative AI – their capabilities, limitations, and ethical considerations. You don't need to be an AI developer, but you must understand how these technologies work at a conceptual level.

- Problem Solver: Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills, with a knack for identifying user needs and framing them as design or research challenges.

- User-Centric Mindset: A deep passion for understanding and advocating for the user.

- Collaboration & Communication: Exceptional ability to collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team and articulate complex ideas clearly (verbally and visually).

- Adaptability & Continuous Learning: Eagerness to learn new technologies and methodologies, particularly in the rapidly evolving AI space. Ability to thrive in an environment with dynamic priorities.

For AI-Focused Experience Designer, you might specialize in:
- Human-AI Interaction Design: Crafting intuitive and engaging interactions for AI-powered solutions (e.g., conversational UIs, recommendation engines, generative content tools).

- End-to-End Design Process for AI-Features: Experienced in the complete AI design lifecycle, from defining user needs to create prototypes and detailed specifications for AI features.

- AI-Powered Prototyping & Visualization: Using AI tools to rapidly prototype experiences or visualize complex AI-driven data for users.

- Designing for AI Transparency & Explainability: Creating interfaces that help users understand and trust AI-driven decisions and outputs.

- Data-Informed Design for AI: Proven ability to utilize user data, AI metrics, and research to design and improve AI outcomes.

- Ethical AI Design: Proactively identifying and mitigating bias and ethical concerns in the design of AI-powered experiences.

- Speculative & Future-State Design: Exploring novel applications of emerging AI to envision future user experiences.

- Holistic AI Experience Evaluation: Assessing the overall AI user experience, including perceived intelligence, usefulness, reliability, and how errors, uncertainty, failures, and edge cases are managed and communicated.

- AI-Augmented Methodologies: Leveraging AI tools for qualitative data analysis (e.g., thematic analysis of interviews, open-ended surveys), sentiment analysis, or identifying patterns in large user datasets.

- Evaluating Experiences with AI-Powered Features: Developing methods to assess the usability, utility, and implications of AI in user-facing applications.

- Generative Synthesis with AI: Using AI to assist in synthesizing data to uncover insights and opportunities for AI application.

- AI and Customer Experience: Understanding AI-driven opportunities to inform proactive CX strategies.

- 6+ years proven experience in Design: (such as UX, CX, Interaction Design, Product Design) Portfolio: Showcasing exceptional UX design for apps and services that showcases your process, skills, and impact. Your portfolio should demonstrate a mastery of UX craft and the ability to drive complex projects. Demonstrable experience in AI assisted workflows and or multimodal interaction design is a plus.

Department Overview
The Centralized Managed Support Operations (CMSO) organization is dedicated to empowering our teams to deliver exceptional support experiences. As part of our commitment to "Solving for safer," CMSO builds agile operational frameworks that keep our teams informed, connected, and equipped to resolve complex technical challenges.
Job Description
The Centralized Managed Support Operations (CMSO) organization is seeking a Knowledge & Learning Program Manager to serve as the dedicated Readiness Partner for the NSOC business unit. In this role, you will bridge the gap between formal technical training and in-the-moment knowledge sharing. You will be responsible for curating agile, role-based learning paths, championing industry-standard knowledge management best practices, and partnering cross-functionally to help ensure support teams are equipped to solve complex problems efficiently.
The ideal candidate understands that learning and knowledge are not just administrative functions, but critical drivers of operational efficiency, faster resolution times, and elevated customer experiences. At Motorola Solutions, everything starts with our people, and this position plays a pivotal role in enabling our teams to perform at their best. Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience is valued for this role.

Key Responsibilities:

Business Unit Readiness & Alignment
- Stakeholder Alignment to serve as the primary Knowledge & Learning (K&L) liaison to NSOC leadership, aligning readiness strategies directly with operational workflows
- Capability Gap Analysis to translate technical capability gaps into actionable, role-based learning paths and knowledge capture strategies
- Operational Readiness to partner cross-functionally and support seamless execution of learning programs across teams

Knowledge Management & Coaching
- Knowledge Management Championing to champion industry-standard knowledge management practices at the team level, helping to ensure accurate incident documentation and rapid capture of zero-day solutions
- Content Health & Metrics to monitor usage and contribution metrics while coaching personnel to improve content health and leverage collective organization experience
- Self-Service Strategy to promote strategies that make internal technical knowledge accessible to external customers and service partners, supporting self-service success and operational parity

Learning Strategy & Governance
- Curriculum Curation to identify technical training gaps, define requirements for content creation with external education partners, and curate modular, agile curriculum blocks that accelerate time-to-proficiency for new hires
- Technology Integration to lead the integration of specialized troubleshooting methodologies and emerging AI technologies into daily support operations
- Cross-Functional Governance to partner with Process Management teams to build training on validated workflows, while providing data-driven requirements to Change Enablement and Platform teams to reduce friction in knowledge capture

Technical Expertise
- Knowledge Management Methodologies to drive best practices in content curation, incident documentation, and knowledge sharing

Would you like to join an incredibly talented group of people, doing very challenging work, with the prime directive of “Keeping Our Heroes Connected”?

Silvus’ rapid growth is fueled by a focus on research and innovation and a team of the most passionate, skilled and creative thinking individuals. If you are looking for a challenging experience, you owe it to yourself to learn how Silvus can be the next chapter of your career.

THE OPPORTUNITY
Silvus Technologies, the global leader in advanced MIMO mesh networking solutions for defense, industrial, and public safety applications, is seeking a Senior Research and Development (R&D) Program Manager who will report to the Vice President of Research and Development (R&D).

This is a foundational role for Silvus R&D that blends technical know-how with strategic thinking and process-oriented execution. This position offers a unique opportunity to shape and deliver key new technology solutions within Silvus’ growing R&D organization. The Program Manager will partner closely with Senior R&D and Engineering leadership, as well as Silvus management, Business Development, and Product teams to define programmatic goals, both technical and strategic, drive cross-functional project execution, and deliver high-impact products to Silvus customers.

This role is part of a passionate team redefining radio frequency (RF) sensing, electronic warfare and wireless connectivity in the most demanding environments, from battlefield networks and autonomous systems to public safety and industrial applications. You will work alongside world-class engineers solving real-world challenges, with opportunities to grow, innovate, and lead as our organization scales.

This position is based at Silvus Technologies’ headquarters in the heart of vibrant West Los Angeles, CA, and is on a hybrid schedule, a minimum of 3 days onsite per week is expected. On-site days are Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays.

NOTE: This is a hybrid role - Candidate must reside in the Chicagoland area with the ability to work from the office 3-day per week.

Position Summary
The Import Trade Operations Lead is a critical role responsible for ensuring the company's strict adherence to all U.S. and Canadian import regulations and compliance standards. This position demands a highly experienced professional with a comprehensive understanding of import operations, HTS classification, and customs brokerage procedures. The successful candidate will serve as a subject matter expert, providing guidance and support to internal teams and external partners to facilitate the smooth and compliant import of goods.

- Broker & Vendor Operations: Manage external U.S. and Canadian customs brokers supporting quality reviews, import declarations, pre/post-entry summary audits, entry data aggregation, and post-summary corrections.
- Audit & Financial Reporting: Prepare financial documentation for ACH duty payment reconciliation, value reconciliation filings (transfer pricing, tooling, assists, pricing changes), support internal and external customs audits, and ensure compliance with US CBP and CBSA import regulations.
- Regulatory Expertise : Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of import regulations and other relevant trade compliance legislation to to optimize compliance, tariff spend and duty treatment.
- Cross-Functional Support: Collaborate daily with purchasing, logistics, engineering, and finance to resolve cross-border shipment delays and drive continuous improvement projects.
- Prioritization & Time Management : Effectively manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

- Experience: Minimum of 5+ years of trade compliance experience focusing specifically on U.S. and Canadian customs operations and import logistics.
- Licensure: A current and valid U.S. Customs Broker License (LCB) is required.
- Regulatory Expertise: In-depth knowledge of U.S. and Canadian (CBSA) import requirements, valuation rules, OGA requirements and tariff classification procedures.
- Preferred Experience: Working knowledge of USMCA rules of origin , Foreign Trade Zones (FTZ) , Duty Drawback , Country of Origin determinations , and Incoterms .

Department Overview
Silvus is seeking a Customer Operations Manager who will report to the International Customer Operations Lead. The successful individual in this role will serve as the primary post-sales operational liaison between our key customers and Silvus manufacturing organization and internal associated departments. The mission is to manage purchase orders, production schedules, delivery coordination to ensure components are delivered on time and integrated successfully into the customer’s long-term production roadmap.
This position is eligible for 100% remote work depending on location.

The following is a list of at least some of the current essential job functions of the position. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time at its discretion
Job Description
Key Responsibilities
- Customer Relationship Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for customer post sale, managing day-to-day operational needs and escalations. Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to report on delivery performance, quality metrics, and roadmap alignment.

- Demand Planning & Forecast Integration: Work directly with customer demand planners to ingest production forecasts. Translate these into actionable data for our internal manufacturing and supply chain teams to prevent stockouts or overages.

- Delivery Management: Track and manage open purchase orders to ensure on-time delivery commitments are met, partnering with manufacturing and logistics to resolve delays.

- Technical Advocacy & Issue Resolution: Identify technical hurdles or integration challenges the customer is facing. Partner with Engineering to resolve issues and manage the formal escalation process for any hardware defects or shipping delays.

- Lifecycle Management: Monitor component performance in the field. Manage the communication of End-of-Life (EOL) notices and transition customers to next-generation components.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the "Voice of the Customer" internally, providing feedback to Product Development to influence the design of future components or products.

- RMA Management: Managing the Return Merchandise Authorization process - making sure that if a part fails, the customer gets a replacement immediately and your engineering team gets the "dead" part back for analysis.

- Regional Expertise: Navigate the specific logistical, legal, and contractual complexities unique to key countries like Germany and the Ukrainian theater.

- Perform other related duties of which the above are representative.

Basic Requirements
- A self-motivated professional who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and takes full ownership of multitasking and shifting priorities.

- Languages: Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills in English and either German or Ukrainian.

- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related technical field.

- Experience: 5+ years in a post-sales, account management, or technical project management role, preferably within the Defense, Aerospace, Robotics, or Semiconductor industries.

- Analytical Prowess: Ability to analyze complex spreadsheets and production schedules to find discrepancies between demand and supply.

- Communication: Demonstrated ability to "translate" between a customer's high-level business needs and a factory's granular production constraints.

- Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with the drone ecosystem (UAV regulations, flight controllers, propulsion systems) is a significant plus. Experience managing military or defense-sector clients is considered a significant asset.

- Clearance: All employment is contingent upon the successful clearance of a background check.

10-25%

None

Experienced

No

Department Overview
Silvus Technologies, a leading provider of advanced MANET and MIMO communications systems, is reshaping mesh network technology for mission-critical applications – on the ground, in the air and at sea. Its battle-proven StreamCaster family of MANET radios and proprietary MN-MIMO waveform provides the vital communications link for defense, law enforcement and public safety agencies around the world, and in the toughest operational environments.

Silvus Technologies is a wholly owned subsidiary of Motorola Solutions, Inc.
Job Description
Would you like to join an incredibly talented group of people, doing very challenging work, with the prime directive of “ Keeping Our Heroes Connected ”?

THE OPPORTUNITY
Silvus is seeking a Customer Operations Manager who will report to the Senior Director of Global Sales Operations and Enablement on the Sales Operations team. The successful individual in this role will serve as the primary post-sales operational liaison between Silvus manufacturing and our largest North America customers, managing purchase orders, production schedules, and delivery coordination to ensure components are delivered on time and integrated successfully into the customer’s production roadmap. The role requires travel to Silvus Headquarters in Los Angeles and throughout the continental U.S. to visit key customers.

This position is eligible for 100% remote work depending on location.

The following is a list of at least some of the current essential job functions of the position. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time at its discretion.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES
●    Serve as the primary point of contact for key North America customers post sale, managing day-to-day operational needs and escalations.
●    Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to report on delivery performance, quality metrics, and production roadmap alignment.
●    Work directly with customer demand planners to ingest and track production forecasts, translating them into actionable data for internal manufacturing and supply chain teams.
●    Track and manage open purchase orders to ensure on-time delivery commitments are met, partnering with manufacturing and logistics to resolve delays.
●    Identify and escalate technical integration challenges, managing the formal escalation process for hardware defects, shipping issues, or field failures.
●    Oversee the Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) process to ensure timely replacement of failed components and recovery of units for failure analysis.
●    Perform other related duties of which the above are representative.
●    Travel Requirement – Up to 30% travel to Silvus HQ in Los Angeles, and throughout the continental U.S. to visit key customers.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Silvus Technologies is a wholly owned subsidiary of Motorola Solutions, Inc.
Job Description
Would you like to join an incredibly talented group of people, doing very challenging work, with the prime directive of “ Keeping Our Heroes Connected ”?

THE OPPORTUNITY
Silvus is seeking an entrepreneurial, strategic, and high-energy Inside Sales Manager to design, build, and scale our first-ever dedicated Inside Sales Department from the ground up. This is a unique opportunity for a builder. You will not just be managing a pipeline; you will be defining the playbooks, selecting the tech stack, structuring the sales support workflows, and hiring the foundational team that will drive new customer acquisition and customer success for our cutting-edge wireless technology. This role reports directly to our Vice President of Sales, North America.

If you are a technical sales leader who thrives on turning ambiguity into process and enjoys leading from the front, this role is for you. This role requires up to 10% travel for business reviews as needed.

This position is 100% onsite, Monday through Friday, at Silvus Technologies’ headquarters in the heart of vibrant West Los Angeles, CA.

The following is a list of at least some of the current essential job functions of the position. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time at its discretion.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Department Architecture & Leadership
- Build the Infrastructure : Establish the core operational framework and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for the new Inside Sales and Support team.
- Team Growth & Mentorship : Recruit, hire, onboard, and train a high-performing team of Inside Sales Representatives (ISRs) and Sales Support Specialists.
- Playbook Development : Design outbound prospecting playbooks, inbound lead qualification frameworks, and post-sale technical support handoff workflows.

Sales & New Customer Creation
- Pipeline Development : Drive outbound strategies targeting new accounts within our key verticals (Unmanned Systems, Defense, Law Enforcement, and Public Safety).
- Lead Qualification : Manage inbound inquiries and coordinate the capture of deep technical and programmatic requirements to ensure high-value opportunities are funneled cleanly to the regional field sales teams.
- Revenue Generation : Own and exceed inside sales revenue targets, focusing on smaller-to-mid-tier accounts, hardware accessory packages, and software capability expansions.

Sales Support & Lifecycle Coordination
- Deal Support : Oversee the creation of accurate technical quotes, proposal developments, RFI/RFP responses, and early-stage capture planning.
- CRM Governance : Own the accuracy of the team's CRM data to provide executive leadership with reliable, predictable forecasting and data-driven market insights.
- Cross-Functional Liaison : Act as the internal connective tissue between Inside Sales, Field Sales Directors, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing to resolve delivery or order constraints smoothly.
- Perform other related duties of which the above are representative.
- Travel Requirement – Up to 10% of travel for business reviews as needed.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Communications, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent experience).
- 5+ years of sales experience in a highly technical field (wireless systems, network infrastructure, aerospace & defense, robotics, or complex embedded systems).
- Leadership : 2+ years of experience managing, mentoring, or acting as a team lead within a tech-focused inside sales, sales development (SDR), or sales operations environment.
- The "Builder" Mindset : Proven track record of creating new sales processes, implementing tech tools, or structuring teams from early stages rather than just executing an existing script.
- Technical Acumen : Ability to learn and confidently articulate complex RF concepts, mesh networking capabilities constraints to technical buyers and engineers.

In Global Procurement, we don’t just manage a supply chain; we build the lifelines that connect people in their moments of greatest need. Every component we source and every partnership we forge directly impacts the reliability of the communication systems used by police, fire, and emergency services worldwide. We are a team of strategic orchestrators, navigating a complex global landscape to ensure that when the call for help comes, the technology is ready. Join us in building a more resilient world.
The Procurement team is moving beyond traditional sourcing goals to create value for the enterprise by improving profitability, increasing supplier collaboration, and supporting new solution development. We are a client focused team designed to bring value and help lead innovations within the enterprise.

Motorola Solutions is building talent pipelines to meet future hiring demands. This is a pipeline role, while there is not an immediate opening, we want to build relationships with prospective candidates like you. If your background is a match to our requirements, we’ll follow up with an exploratory conversation.

The Procurement Compliance Project Manager serves as the critical bridge between operational sourcing and corporate integrity. You won’t just be "checking boxes"; you will be the architect of a transparent supply chain. This role requires a blend of project management rigor, data literacy, and the diplomatic skill to navigate complex regulatory environments.

Core Responsibilities
1. Strategy Management & Reporting
- Operational Governance: Translate high-level procurement strategies into tactical project plans with clear milestones (e.g., Small Business Subcontracting goals or Sustainability targets).

- Audit Readiness: Beyond conducting audits, you will develop "Self-Assessment" toolkits for buyers to prevent non-compliance before it occurs.

- Regulatory Translation: Act as the subject matter expert (SME) on U.S. Federal requirements, ensuring the team stays ahead of changing legislation (e.g., Section 889, Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act).

2. Data Analytics & Integrity
- Predictive Risk Modeling: Move beyond retrospective reporting to identify trends in supplier data that indicate potential financial instability or geopolitical risk.

- System Ownership: Act as the functional lead for Procurement Contract Management (CLM) or ERP systems to ensure the "Source of Truth" remains untainted.

- Visualization: Convert raw datasets from SQL or Excel into executive-ready visualizations (PowerBI/Tableau) that tell a story of risk vs. reward.

3. Stakeholder Engagement
- Cross-Functional Diplomacy: Mediate between Engineering’s need for speed, Legal’s need for protection, and Finance’s need for cost-control.

- Training & Enablement: Design and deliver training sessions to the broader Supply Chain team to foster a culture of "Compliance by Design.

Location: Employee must be based in the Greater Chicago Area with the expectation to be in office 3 days per week.

jobs.description:

Department Overview
Applied Technology. The Applied Technology organization puts some of Motorola Solutions' brightest minds on unique, highly challenging projects. Based on decades of experience with our customers, we apply leading-edge technologies to support security and safety throughout the world. We engineer our products from start to finish and manufacture them in-house. We deliver high capability with focused specialization in areas including software-defined radios, signals intelligence, advanced antenna solutions, artificial intelligence and machine learning, cyber security, and more. Our customer-centric, team-based environment is proud to support today’s modern war fighter.
Job Description
In this role, you will be responsible for business development within Applied Technology with a primary focus on the Army Special Operations Forces (ARSOF) enterprise. You will drive and expand business across USASOC, 1st Special Forces Command (Airborne), and the Special Forces Groups, spanning strategic headquarters relationships down to tactical ODA-level engagement. You will promote and maintain strong relationships with ARSOF stakeholders and leverage existing programs while creating new market opportunities for specialized mission sets.

As part of the AT Business Development team, you will provide technical support to customers, demonstrate capabilities to current and potential partners, and interpret complex requirements to ensure AT products exceed expectations for the Army Special Operations community. You will work collaboratively across the organization including Business Development, Field Services, Development Engineering, Early Capture, and Senior Management.

Specific responsibilities include:

• Demonstrate AT products to USASOC and USASFC leadership, G-shops (including G2, G25, and G39), and Special Forces Group end users, emphasizing advantages for Ground, Airborne and UAS-integrated missions.
• Grow the business by identifying opportunities across the ARSOF enterprise—from USASOC and 1st SFC headquarters to the 1st, 3rd, 5th, 7th, and 10th Special Forces Groups—and providing technical support to facilitate capture.
• Interpret customer requirements, communicating these needs to the development team to influence product roadmaps.
• Manage the business development process with specific attention to ARSOF opportunity identification, screening, forecasting, and capture across strategic and tactical levels.
• Participate in internal product testing and technical experiments (TEs) to ensure features are optimized for Airborne environments and ruggedized SOF use cases.
• Support trade shows, technical experiments, industry days, and customer engagements by showcasing AT’s advantages in the tactical communications space.
• Engage key ARSOF-aligned organizations and partners including SOCPAC, DTRA-Germany, Capability Development and Innovation (CD&I, formerly IWTSD), and others as relevant to the portfolio.

Specific Knowledge/Skills

• Deep familiarity and experience with SIGINT & EW mission requirements and tactical integration in the Army Special Operations environment.
• Proven experience with SIGINT & EW Tactical operations.
• Strong working knowledge of USASOC and 1st Special Forces Command structure, acquisition processes, and SOF requirements generation (including SOFCIDS/UFR pathways).
• Strong understanding of SIGINT/EW/ELINT/Cyber and Secure COMMS product requirements and sustainment.
• Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to navigate the unique culture of the Special Operations community—from 4-star headquarters to tactical ODA teams.
• Must be technically savvy with the ability to bridge the gap between company technical capabilities and complex operator requirements.
• Ability to travel on a regular basis (5-10 days/month) to support testing, Group-level engagements, and customer visits across key ARSOF locations (including JBLM, Fort Bragg, Fort Campbell, Eglin AFB, Fort Carson, and other relevant sites).

Silvus Technologies, a Motorola Solutions company, is dedicated to one mission: connecting those who keep us safe. We do so by delivering the most advanced Mobile Ad-hoc Network (MANET) radios powered by our custom and ever evolving Mobile-Networked MIMO waveform. - Tactical Communications to demonstrate knowledge of MANET ecosystems, RF networking, and wireless network integration

jobs.title: Director of Business Development, U.S. ARMY
jobs.description:
Company Overview
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview
Silvus Technologies, a leading provider of advanced MANET and MIMO communications systems, is reshaping mesh network technology for mission-critical applications – on the ground, in the air and at sea. Its battle-proven StreamCaster family of MANET radios and proprietary MN-MIMO waveform provides the vital communications link for defense, law enforcement and public safety agencies around the world, and in the toughest operational environments.

Silvus Technologies is a wholly owned subsidiary of Motorola Solutions, Inc.
Job Description
Would you like to join an incredibly talented group of people, doing very challenging work, with the prime directive of “ Keeping Our Heroes Connected ”?

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Director of Business Development, U.S. Army reports to the Market Development Executive (MDE), Army/USSOCOM . This role is responsible for long-term horizon scanning and opportunity shaping, focusing on managing and driving multi-year pursuits for assigned strategic programs. The Director develops deep, broad relationships with all buying stakeholders (end-user, OEM, prime, reseller, PM offices) to guide capability requirements toward Silvus solutions and capture large, long-cycle programs.

This position is eligible for 100% remote work depending on location.

The following is a list of at least some of the current essential job functions of the position. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time at its discretion.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES
- Program Capture: Take ownership of and drive the capture process for large-scale, multi-year U.S. Army programs.

- Relationship Building: Identify, cultivate, and maintain deep relationships with all buying influences on assigned programs, including Program Offices (PEOs/PMs), prime contractors, OEM partners, and key end-user communities.

- Requirements Shaping: Proactively work with customers and partners to influence technical requirements for long-term programs, positioning Silvus's MN-MIMO technology as a critical component.

- Strategic Pursuits: Manage the full lifecycle of long-cycle pursuits, from initial identification and qualification (horizon scanning) to proposal and award.

- Cross-Functional Teaming: Collaborate closely with the Market Development Executive (MDE) to align high-level strategy and with Account Sales to ensure a smooth transition of "landed" programs for near-term execution.

- Market Intelligence: Stay updated on market trends, competitor actions, and funding priorities related to assigned programs to inform capture strategy.

- Travel Requirement – Up to 50% of the time will be required to facilitate strong customer engagement and to advance company goals and profitability.

- Perform other related duties of which the above are representative.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university; or High School Diploma/GED with at least 8 years of relevant experience.

- A minimum 5+ years of experience in defense sales or business development, specifically focused on U.S. Army.

- Proven track record of capturing complex, long-cycle Department of Defense programs (Programs of Record).

- Demonstrated experience building relationships within U.S. Army Acquisition offices and with relevant prime contractors.

- Experience leading all phases of business capture (whitepapers, proposals, RFI/RFP response, teaming, strategic positioning).

- Practical understanding of product development, technology transitioning, and marketing/product planning for US military applications.

- Knowledge of conducting and directing competitive product analysis using market research techniques and a solid technical understanding of service/agency needs and requirements.

- Strong persuasive communication and executive briefing skills.

- Deep familiarity with U.S. Army organizational structure, acquisition processes, and capability development lifecycle.

- Solid understanding of U.S. Department of Defense funding and procurement cycles.

- Security Clearance: Active U.S. Government SECRET clearance or the ability to obtain one within 15 months of hire.

- Must be a U.S. Citizen due to clients under U.S. government contracts.

- All employment is contingent upon the successful clearance of a background check and drug test.

PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES
- Prior United States military service or civilian experience.

- Leadership, management, and program management experience.

- Deep technical understanding of tactical communications, MANET, C5ISR, and U.S. Military tactical communications networks.

WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
- Trade shows.

- Indoor air-conditioned facility.

- Occasional exposure to heat, cold, and allergens while performing tests or demonstrations in the field.

- While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to do the following:
- Lift equipment up to 50 lbs. for the set-up of demonstrations and testing.

- Manage the movement of large suitcase-size Pelican cases (i.e. travel, demonstrations, etc.)

jobs.description:
Company Overview
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview
The Motorola Solutions Rave and Command Center Software Customer Success team plays a critical role in realizing Motorola Solutions’ mission to connect people in the moments that matter. Our team ensures that Rave and the Command Center Software portfolio delivers measurable value to public safety agencies and enterprises by driving deep product adoption, workflow optimization, and long-term customer loyalty.

Within this organization, Customer Success Advocates focus on our most critical and complex customers, acting as trusted advisors who align Motorola Solutions’ capabilities with each customer’s strategic priorities. CSAs use data, product expertise, and a deep understanding of customer operations to guide stakeholders through advanced use cases, maximize the impact of our mission-critical solutions, and strengthen multi-year partnerships.

We partner closely with Sales, Product, Deployment, and Support teams across Motorola Solutions to translate our mission-critical technology into outcomes that protect communities and streamline operations. By being customer-obsessed and data-informed, the Customer Success organization helps customers fully integrate our solutions into daily operations, maximize their investment, and advocate for Motorola
Job Description
The Customer Success Advocate is a front-line, customer-facing role responsible for ensuring that customers realize the full value of Motorola Solutions’ hybrid-cloud portfolio. This role focuses on driving product adoption, advancing workflow maturity, and strengthening long-term relationships. Success is measured by the ability to turn technology investments into measurable outcomes through high adoption, retention, and customer advocacy.

As a Customer Success Advocate, you will manage a portfolio of customers within an assigned region, working under the guidance of the Senior Manager, Regional Customer Success. You will engage end users and key stakeholders to ensure our solutions are successfully onboarded, configured for real-world workflows, and consistently used in mission-critical scenarios.

Responsibilities/Expectations:
- Reducing Time to First Value for new deployments.
- Moving customers through increasingly advanced usage tiers.
- Identifying risks to adoption and retention early and driving mitigation plans.
- Surfacing expansion and cross-sell opportunities based on usage and outcomes.​

Customer Engagement & Adoption:
- Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with operational leadership and end users across your assigned customer portfolio.
- Lead regular customer touchpoints (e.g., onboarding, QBRs/EBRs, health checks) to review usage, outcomes, and future needs.
- Ensure customers and key work partners clearly understand the “why behind the buy” and that configurations align to their operational goals and workflows.
- Drive high adoption of licensed features, with specific focus on daily active usage and mission-critical workflows.

Workflow Maturity & Value Realization:
- Apply a “Good-Better-Best” framework to guide customers from basic use to advanced, integrated workflows.
- Use usage statistics and customer feedback to recommend configuration changes, workflow enhancements, and best practices.
- Partner with customers to define success criteria, baselines, and measurable outcomes (e.g., response times, call handling efficiency, situational awareness).
- Document and communicate customer success stories, including measurable impacts and operational improvements.

Health Monitoring & Risk Management:
- Monitor account health via adoption, license activation, utilization, and customer feedback data.
- Identify early warning signs of churn risk or declining engagement and execute mitigation plans in partnership with the Senior Manager and cross-functional teams.
- Capture and escalate customer issues, blockers, and product gaps to the appropriate internal teams (Support, Product, Deployment) to drive resolution.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:
- Collaborate closely with Sales, Deployment, Product Activation, and Support to ensure a seamless customer experience from deployment through renewal.
- Provide structured feedback to Product and Sales on customer needs, feature requests, and usage trends.
- Support Sales in renewal and expansion cycles by providing adoption insights, success stories, and risk assessments.

Preferred Skills:

Department Overview
In Global Procurement, we don’t just manage a supply chain; we build the lifelines that connect people in their moments of greatest need. Every component we source and every partnership we forge directly impacts the reliability of the communication systems used by police, fire, and emergency services worldwide. We are a team of strategic orchestrators, navigating a complex global landscape to ensure that when the call for help comes, the technology is ready. Join us in building a more resilient world.
The Procurement team is moving beyond traditional sourcing goals to create value for the enterprise by improving profitability, increasing supplier collaboration, and supporting new solution development. We are a client focused team designed to bring value and help lead innovations within the enterprise.
Job Description
Motorola Solutions is building talent pipelines to meet future hiring demands. This is a pipeline role, while there is not an immediate opening, we want to build relationships with prospective candidates like you. If your background is a match to our requirements, we’ll follow up with an exploratory conversation.

The Strategic Sourcing Manager - Indirect Procurement is the commercial architect for our global Business Services categories. You are responsible for more than just buying; you are tasked with creating a competitive advantage by optimizing how the company spends millions of dollars on non-production services. This role requires a "consultative" approach—partnering with executive leaders to ensure their departments have the best tools and services to succeed while protecting the company's bottom line.

Core Responsibilities
1. Category Strategy & Market Intelligence
- Global Strategy Development: Move beyond tactical buying to create 3-year category roadmaps that account for global market volatility, labor trends, and technological shifts (e.g., AI integration in services).

- Supply Base Optimization: Don't just manage vendors; curate a high-performing supply base. This includes "right-sizing" the number of vendors to leverage volume while mitigating "single-source" risks.

- Should-Cost Modeling: Build complex financial models to understand the cost drivers of services (labor rates, overhead, margins) to enter negotiations with a data-driven advantage.

2. Strategic Sourcing & Lifecycle Management
- Advanced RFx Execution: Design "Value-Based" RFPs that prioritize outcomes and KPIs rather than just the lowest price.

- Contractual Engineering: Partner with Legal to draft robust Master Service Agreements (MSAs) and Statements of Work (SOWs) that include "teeth"—clear SLAs, liquidated damages, and continuous improvement clauses.

- Supplier Relationship Management (SRM): Lead quarterly Strategic Business Reviews (SBRs) with "Tier 1" suppliers to drive innovation and ensure we are their "Customer of Choice."

3. Financial Impact & Value Creation
- Total Cost of Ownership (TCO): Shift the conversation from "price" to "value," identifying hidden costs in service delivery, implementation, and off-boarding.

- Working Capital Optimization: Negotiate favorable payment terms and lead-time reductions to maximize corporate cash flow.

- Demand Management: Work with internal departments to challenge "need vs. want," reducing unnecessary consumption of services at the source.

Location: Employee must be based in the Greater Chicago Area with the expectation to be in office 3 days per week.

- Cost Optimization & Financial Stewardship: Drive aggressive software spend optimization, license management efficiency, and value engineering while utilizing benchmarking and total cost of ownership (TCO) modeling.

- Team Leadership & Talent Development: Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of global strategic sourcing professionals, fostering a culture of high performance, accountability, and innovation.

- Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, Management, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. (Master's degree or MBA preferred).

- Leadership Track Record: Proven experience leading strategic initiatives, managing key executive stakeholders, and driving high-value enterprise deals in high-tech, telecommunications, or safety technology environments.

- Contracting Expertise: Advanced expertise in drafting and negotiating complex software, SaaS, IP, cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), and security services agreements.

- Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of software licensing models, cybersecurity frameworks, third-party risk management (TPRM), open-source software governance, and SaaS cost-structure modeling.

- Executive Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to summarize complex commercial and technical terms for executive leadership.

Department Overview
The Supply Chain organization is a fast-paced and dynamic environment, delivering best-in-class communications equipment and solutions for customers around the world. Our purpose is to deliver exceptional value and customer experience through agility, speed, and collaboration. We plan what products and services are needed, source efficiently and ethically from a diverse supply base, launch new products, make and deliver solutions on time, and exceed customer expectations through outstanding quality, service, and support. Job Description
As a Procurement / Supplier Manager, you will provide strategic leadership and expert oversight for high-value, mission-critical supplier contracts. You will act as the primary commercial lead, ensuring all contractual arrangements are robust, compliant, and optimised to support the delivery of essential communications services to UK blue light customers. You will bridge the gap between technical, operational, finance and legal functions, translating complex contractual obligations into actionable business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities
- Strategic Contract Leadership: Lead the full 3rd party contract lifecycle for key strategic and operational suppliers, encompassing the entire journey from mobilisation and performance management to renewal or exit strategies.
- Commercial Negotiation & Governance: Lead negotiations for complex contract changes, renewals, and new service agreements. Ensure all commercial agreements align with company strategy, risk appetite, and Delegation of Authority (DOA) processes.
- Legal & Regulatory Compliance: Provide expert guidance on UK and European contract law, data protection, and regulatory requirements specific to the telecommunications sector. Manage complex contract change requests by evaluating customer requirements and coordinating with legal and commercial teams. Maintain consistent adherence to ISO 9001 and ISO 2000 standards as a critical contractual commitment to our key customers.
- Performance & Risk Management: Monitor supplier performance against rigorous SLAs and KPIs. Drive continuous improvement through Service Improvement Plans (SIPs). Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate commercial and supply chain risks, establishing robust contingency plans.
- Financial Stewardship: Oversee supplier costs to ensure compliance with agreed contract rates. Validate charges and service credits, and work closely with finance teams to track expenditures against budgets and identify cost-saving initiatives.
- Stakeholder Engagement: Act as the central point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, including senior leadership, technical operational leads, legal, and finance. Chair strategic supplier review meetings to drive accountability and alignment.

Team Development: Support procurement team, promoting best practices and developing commercial acumen within the team

Basic Requirements
- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business, Commercial Management, or a related field.
- Professional Certification: Membership or certification from a relevant body (e.g., MCIPS or WorldCC) is highly desirable.
- Experience: 5+ years of demonstrable experience in contract or supplier management within the telecommunications, IT services, or mission-critical infrastructure sectors.
- Legal Knowledge: Comprehensive understanding of English contract law, with working knowledge of relevant European regulatory frameworks.
- Commercial Acumen: Proven success in negotiating complex commercial agreements and managing high-value, multi-site service portfolios.
- The role currently has no direct reports.
- Skills: * Expertise in document drafting, review, and contract lifecycle management software. - Strong analytical skills to interpret performance data and financial models.
- Excellent interpersonal and influencing skills, comfortable presenting to and negotiating with senior executive stakeholders.
- Full UK driving license and flexibility to travel within the UK as required.

In return for your expertise, we’ll support you in this new challenge with coaching & development every step of the way. Also, to reward your hard work you’ll get:

We focus on removing friction across the sales lifecycle, ensuring data integrity, building actionable analytical insights, and aligning sales compensation with executive performance objectives to support "Solving for safer" across all our markets.
Job Description
The Senior Sales Operations Analyst - Compensation plays a pivotal role in driving the operational execution and integrity of our global sales incentive programs. In this role, you will collaborate with the Global Sales Compensation team to help ensure field sales personnel are paid accurately and on time, maintain data integrity across systems, manage territory alignment and hierarchy changes, administer SPIFFs, and resolve commission inquiries with transparency and professionalism.

The ideal candidate possesses deep analytical rigor, expertise in automated Sales Performance Management (SPM) platforms, and strong communication skills to translate complex compensation logic into clear insights for sales leadership and field representatives. At Motorola Solutions, work in a people-first culture, innovate what's next, and pursue your passion and potential while enabling safer communities, safer schools, and safer businesses. Candidates with a Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

Data Integrity & System Reconciliation
- Audit transaction data, POS feeds, order crediting rules, and CRM records daily to identify missing revenue, uncredited orders, or system logic errors before credit finalization
- Conduct periodic data reconciliation between CRM (Salesforce), ERP (SAP/NetSuite), and SPM systems (Oracle OIC / Callidus) to maintain a single source of truth for revenue attainment
- Manage monthly and quarterly commission disputes, manual adjustments, postal code validation mapping, pencil credits, and quarterly true-up reconciliations to help ensure 100% attainment accuracy and strict adherence to payroll deadlines

Compensation Plan Modeling & Territory Alignment
- Lead financial modeling for quota setting, quota allocation, baseline targets, and proration for new hires or mid-year territory reorganizations
- Oversee end-to-end sales credit assignments, territory mappings (zip codes, named accounts, verticals), and user roles within SPM and CRM platforms
- Collaborate with HR, Sales Ops, and Compensation teams to ensure new hire onboarding and role changes are seamlessly mapped to correct compensation plan templates

Field Stakeholder Support & Analytics Optimization
- Act as the primary point of contact for sales reps and leadership, investigating complex commission disputes, performing root-cause analyses, and providing clear, data-backed explanations
- Design, model, track, and audit Short-Term Incentive Fund (SPIFF) campaigns, managing payout schedules and executive reporting on campaign ROI
- Identify operational bottlenecks in the compensation lifecycle, document SOPs, build Tableau/Excel dashboards, and leverage generative AI tools to automate repetitive workflows

Job Requirements

Technical Expertise
- Sales Performance Management (SPM) administration experience with enterprise SPM software (e.g., Oracle Incentive Compensation / OIC, CallidusCloud, Xactly, Varicent, or Anaplan)
- Salesforce (SFDC) proficiency, including reporting, custom objects, and data structures
- Data Analytics & BI Tools expertise using advanced Excel/Google Sheets (XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, nested conditionals) and building dashboards in Tableau or PowerBI
- AI & Automation proficiency leveraging generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini) to accelerate data analysis, write complex formulas or SQL queries, and automate administrative tasks
- SQL & Database Auditing experience writing SQL queries for dataset validation and managing confidential metrics under tight deadlines

Professional Experience
- Financial Modeling experience leading quota allocation, target setting, SPIFF design, and compensation plan mechanics within an enterprise environment
- Stakeholder Support & Conflict Resolution experience handling field commission inquiries with composure, diplomacy, and data-backed explanations
- Process Optimization track record of identifying operational bottlenecks, writing detailed SOPs, and implementing automated workflows across CRM and ERP systems

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with ERP systems such as SAP or NetSuite

Job Description
Role Summary
We are seeking a strategic and highly experienced Director of Sales Engineering to lead our technical pre-sales engineering and field application engineering teams. In this role, you will be the ultimate technical authority in the sales cycle, helping turn customer requirements into credible solutions built around CRFS products. You will lead and manage a growing UK-based technical team, directly managing two Pre-Sales Engineers while overseeing the entire Field Application Engineering (FAE) team through their dedicated manager.

This role serves as the critical bridge uniting the Technical, Sales, and Product teams. While you will not oversee the Sales or Product teams directly, you will be the link that ensures these groups operate in total alignment. We need a leader who has grown up in the pre-sales space, someone who can drive high-level strategy, step in as the senior technical voice on active deals to help get them over the line, while also deepening relationships with current clients to spot new opportunities for the sales team. You must have the practical hardware and software knowledge needed to earn the respect of our most technical clients.

What You’ll Do
- Lead and Scale the Technical Sales team: Direct a blended team of Pre-Sales and Field Application Engineers. Mentor direct reports, empower the FAE manager, and build a high-performance culture focused on technical excellence.
- Commercial Expansion & Relationship Building: While you will not carry a direct sales quota, you will play a vital commercial role. You will be responsible for expanding and deepening relationships with existing customers, identifying new technical challenges, and uncovering new opportunities to feed back to the sales team.
- Cross-Functional Bridge: Act as the primary conduit between the sales team, the product teams, and your engineering staff, helping ensure customer needs and market signals flow effectively in all directions. You will influence the product roadmap based on field intelligence without taking on direct product management responsibilities.
- Executive Customer Engagement: Act as the senior technical sponsor for strategic accounts. Lead or contribute to customer meetings, presentations, workshops, and live demonstrations, tailoring your communication to audiences ranging from senior military officers and procurement leads to hands-on analysts.
- Drive Pre-Sales Strategy: Oversee the technical qualification and solution design process from initial qualification through to contract award. Ensure your team effectively translates what customers need into solutions that are technically sound.
- Operational Excellence: Standardise how the team builds and demonstrates solutions, tests product capabilities against specific customer requirements, and assesses compatibility with third-party systems. Ensure the team maintains composure and methodology when troubleshooting under pressure, during a demo, or in the field.

What We’re Looking For
- A Pre-Sales Background: You must have built your career in pre-sales and sales engineering. We are looking for someone who has lived the pre-sales lifecycle and understands the nuances of the role, not someone who has only managed it from afar.
- Hardware & Software Acumen: You must have demonstrable experience engineering, selling, or supporting solutions that involve complex integrations of both hardware and software.
- Customer-Facing Capability: Technical knowledge alone isn't enough; you need to be someone customers trust, enjoy working with, and want to see again. You must be skilled at listening—understanding not just what a customer is asking for, but what they actually need.

Essential

The Senior Security Compliance Analyst is responsible for supporting the organization's efforts to maintain compliance with applicable regulatory, statutory, and contractual requirements, as well as internal security policies and standards. The role involves supporting assessments, monitoring compliance activities, assisting with risk management, and helping stakeholders ensure the organization’s information security posture aligns with industry best practices and frameworks. Compliance Management

- Track and manage risk exceptions, ensuring appropriate documentation and approvals.

- Assist in preparing and providing evidence to demonstrate compliance with applicable standards and requirements.
- Monitor and track the completion of audit findings and corrective actions.
- Partner with the ISO ISPMS Leads to facilitate regular management update(s), highlighting  compliance changes, integrity adherence  and stakeholder updates.

- Support the development and enhancement of security and compliance tools, processes, and frameworks.

- Support the development of the Information Security strategy and roadmap.
- Track and report on compliance with critical international regulations, such as the EU CRA and EU Radio Equipment Directive.

- Foundational understanding of risk assessment methodologies, control frameworks, and compliance requirements.

Company Overview
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview
The Sales team at CRFS Cambridge drives global growth by delivering industry-leading spectrum monitoring and electronic warfare solutions to defence, regulatory, and security agencies. They bridge the gap between complex RF engineering and client requirements, ensuring partners have the actionable intelligence needed to manage and secure the spectrum.
Job Description
As the Sales Manager for APAC, you will be the lead for CRFS in one of the worlds most critical and diverse defence markets. You will be responsible for identifying high-value opportunities within your area of responsibility, defence and adjacent markets, plus various internal security agencies, ensuring our RFeye ecosystem is the standard for regional signals intelligence and border security:
·        Design and execute a multi-year growth strategy for your APAC region
·        Align CRFS technology with the specific tactical needs of the regional Armed Forces, focusing on border protection, anti-drone (C-UAS) operations, and APAC interoperability.
·        Act as the primary subject matter expert in-region. You will deliver technical briefings on signal processing and EW to regional technical leads, program managers, and military commanders.
·        Lead the response to complex regional public tenders. You will navigate the country and region Public Procurement Law and offset requirements, moving deals from RFI stage to final contract signature.
·        Build and manage strategic partnerships with local and regional defence integrators and distributors to extend CRFS’s reach across the APAC region.
·        Act as the strategic link between end-users and our UK-based engineering teams to ensure our product roadmap reflects the unique challenges of the Asia Pacific region.

Basic Requirements
·  Experience: 5–10 years of experience in high-end technical sales or business development within the Defence, Aerospace, or Electronic Warfare sectors in the APAC region.
·  Clearance: Must hold (or be eligible for) National Security Clearance (Secret or higher). Citizenship of an APAC country is preferred.
·  Technical Proficiency: A strong grasp of RF principles, SIGINT, or Spectrum Management. You should be comfortable explaining why a 100MHz real-time bandwidth matters to a tactical commander.
·  The "Rolodex": An established network within the regions defence and security industry including intimacy with a number of military commands from at least 3 countries.
